findings.title: Director lacks searchable semantic memory
findings.description: 90s/60s windows, last 12 leads; range reads require already localized timestamps, cap four and 180s; both directions allowed within section.
findings.limitations: Source static audit; no runtime rerun.

findings.title: MAGIC-Video combines multimodal graph and narrative chain
findings.description: Authors report improvements of 10.1/7.4/5.9 points over prior best agentic systems on EgoLifeQA/Ego-R1/MM-Lifelong.
findings.limitations: Question-answering, not editorial discovery; not independently reproduced.

findings.title: MAGIC offline preprocessing is expensive
findings.description: Appendix I estimates ~4805 neural operations per captioned hour, including 3600 visual captions; 76.4h actual captioned MM-Lifelong Month subset. Four-hour extrapolation ~19220 ops before NMC.
findings.limitations: Operation count not API call count, latency or dollars.
findings.relevance: Favor selective modalities and account total cost.

findings.title: MAGIC graph retrieval is undirected PPR × cosine with quotas
findings.description: Combined seed text/BM25/visual, PPR undirected, rerank by shifted text cosine, result caps 8/4/3/0 for 30s/3min/10min/1h.
findings.limitations: Static trace; no upstream execution. Association does not prove identity or causal support.
findings.relevance: Graph optional ablation, raw rescue required.

findings.title: MAGIC uses dataset-specific clocks and derived IDs
findings.description: EgoLife DHHMMSSFF, broadcast float seconds, visual IDs integer seconds; normalize first person to subject.
findings.limitations: No multi-speaker identity validation; static audit.
findings.relevance: Use source-scoped integer ms and occurrence refs.

findings.title: MAGIC controller has bounded search and node dedup
findings.description: WorldMemory._answer_unified uses search/answer with max rounds/errors; direct temporal reads; graph results dedup by node ID; visual frame budget.
findings.limitations: Final chain injection and stopping path not fully traced.
findings.relevance: Adapt bounded evidence planning; do not force QA answer.

findings.title: Keystone evidence and budgets are reusable
findings.description: Content-derived research evidence IDs bind source interval, modality, provenance and fingerprint; default total120 allocated 115/4/1; cache key includes source/provider/phase/schema/prompt.
findings.relevance: Add adapter and review; keep immutable evidence.

findings.title: RAPTOR has both collapsed and top-down tree retrieval
findings.description: Parent summaries attach child IDs; collapsed search ranks all nodes then breaks when one exceeds remaining token budget; top-down narrows to selected children.
findings.limitations: No upstream inference; license exact file not found.
findings.relevance: Independent raw retrieval and token packing ablation.

findings.title: HippoRAG 2 has dense rescue but repeated text metadata hazard
findings.description: Index uses content hash for chunk ID and overwrites conflicting metadata with warning; retrieves dense passages when fact rerank empty.
findings.limitations: Current code HippoRAG 2, not original 2024 exact implementation.
findings.relevance: Preserve same-text occurrences by time and use raw rescue.

findings.title: GraphRAG separates context token allocation
findings.description: LocalSearchMixedContext budgets raw text, community summaries and entity/relationship data independently, returns context records.
findings.limitations: No indexed experiment; construction cost unresolved.

findings.title: VideoAgent QA parsing can randomize invalid outputs
findings.description: Out-of-range answer/confidence returns random value; cache miss prompts input before API call; controller proposes evidence frame descriptions.
findings.limitations: Partial static audit; no model execution.
findings.relevance: Reject random fallback; adapt search description only.

findings.title: MovieChat uses compressed visual feature memory
findings.description: Short frame buffer merges adjacent similar representations and appends to long memory; separate visual path caps long buffer.
findings.limitations: No raw provenance retrieval established; model weights not run.
findings.relevance: Do not replace evidence store with learned tokens.

findings.title: Synthetic E001 flat retrieval finds 10 of 12 essential references
findings.description: 10 positive cases; BM25, lexical cosine, RRF, entity and graph each hit 10/12, all essential in 8/10. Nearby hits 0/12, deliberately remote design.
findings.limitations: Authored synthetic queries, no independent gold, dense model, matched tokens or real footage. REPRODUCED means local mechanics executed, not upstream score reproduction.
findings.relevance: Establish flat baseline; no graph superiority claim.

findings.title: Synthetic summary gate misses evidence; raw rescue partly recovers
findings.description: Hierarchy 7/12; hierarchy raw rescue 9/12; all non-nearby methods return empty in 1/2 no-support cases.
findings.limitations: Toy first-five-token compression; not actual abstractive hierarchy. No abstention classifier.

findings.title: Separate interpretation context from viewer-essential clip spans
findings.description: Sidecar search returns source refs, unresolved requirements and budget; no automatic expansion of final contiguous clip.
findings.limitations: Proposed contract, no production integration or peer approval.
findings.relevance: Allow distant evidence without unfaithful extraction.

findings.title: Progressive architecture and explicit stopping
findings.description: Start with global lexical and temporal index; test parallel hierarchy, then graph only if gains. Stop closed, outside source, no new evidence, budget exhausted or unresolved.
findings.limitations: Not approved; no agentic query generation measured.
findings.relevance: Constrain investigative cost and false closure.
